svg.title: Standard BPE vs Combinatorial BPE on the same text
svg.desc: Standard BPE needs 21 tokens, Combinatorial BPE 15; Traditional and Simplified Chinese map to identical cores.

svg.text: variation: Aa = Capitalised, AA = UPPER, 繁 = Traditional, none = as-is

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, 'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif

svg.text: · marks a space. Cores are stored case-folded (and in Simplified for Chinese); the variation restores the surface form.
